直覺不是運氣，也不是憑空亂猜。: Intuition isn't luck, and it isn't a wild guess.
它是你過去所有的經驗，在一瞬間給出的判斷。: It's everything you've ever experienced, giving you a judgment in a single moment.
如果你常常「感覺是對的，但又怕錯」，多半是因為我們從小被教著聽外面的指令，慢慢忘: If you often feel "this seems right, but I'm afraid I'm wrong", it's usually because we were taught from childhood to follow instructions from outside, and slowly forgot how to listen to ourselves.
直覺不是超能力。它是一種可以重新練回來的能力。: Intuition isn't a superpower. It's an ability you can practice your way back to.
今天做一個小決定時，先寫下第一個直覺。晚上回頭看看，它準不準。: The next time you make a small decision today, write down your first instinct. Tonight, look back and see whether it was right.
